choices.topic: Missing starting measurement in the change scores?
choices.opus: All 3 runs: left the person with no baseline out of the four walking and stair change scores (22 people).
choices.sonnet: Same: used only the 22 people with both visits.
choices.authors: Included that person with a starting value of 0 (23 people); reproduces all four published scores.
choices.matters: All runs: 4 change-score (SRM) cells (timed up and go, 6-minute walk, stair up, stair down).

choices.opus: All 3 runs: SPSS-style normal approximation, zero differences dropped, no continuity correction.
choices.sonnet: Same SPSS-style normal approximation without continuity correction; rejected exact test.
choices.authors: Not known; the exact settings are unknown and four p-values stay unexplained.
choices.matters: All runs: 4 p-values (hip flexion, knee extension, timed up and go, stair descent) off; no setting fixes them.

choices.topic: Medians: everyone with a value, or only paired people?
choices.opus: All 3 runs: only people with both visits, matching the footnote counts.
choices.sonnet: Same: paired people only for medians, tests and change scores.
choices.authors: Used everyone measured at each visit, which adds people measured at 6 years only.
choices.matters: All runs: 3 six-year median cells (FVC lying, stair descent, chair rise).

choices.topic: Chair-rise change score: keep the 10,000 s 'unable' code?
choices.opus: Runs 1, 3: only the 13 pairs with real times at both visits. Run 2: kept 10,000 s (0.74).
choices.sonnet: Used only the 13 people able at both visits.
choices.authors: Not known; the published table shows N/A for this cell.

choices.topic: Keep the 10,000 s 'unable' code in chair-rise medians?
choices.opus: All 3 runs: kept it; a median only needs ranks, so it ranks last.
choices.sonnet: Kept it in medians and the Wilcoxon test; rejected dropping it.
choices.authors: Kept it: the published 9.8 s is reproduced only with the code kept.

choices.topic: Chair-rise count: footnote says 17, data give 22?
choices.opus: All 3 runs: used all 22 pairs; no rule in the Methods gives 17.
choices.sonnet: Used 22 pairs; could not reconcile with the footnote's 17.

choices.topic: Direction and spread used in change scores (SRM)?
choices.opus: All 3 runs: follow-up minus baseline, standard deviation with n - 1.

choices.topic: Score for people unable to do a walking test?
choices.opus: All 3 runs: used the deposited velocities, which already hold 0 for unable.
choices.sonnet: Used the deposited values (0 for unable), no recoding.

choices.topic: Include the hip flexion row not listed in Methods?
choices.opus: All 3 runs: computed it from the deposited hip flexion columns like other strength rows.
choices.sonnet: Included it as its own row from the deposited columns.

choices.topic: Report FVC sitting and lying separately?
choices.opus: All 3 runs: separate sitting and lying rows, both already in percent of predicted.
choices.sonnet: Used sitting and lying columns as separate rows.
